name: Red Pill Blue Pill
look: A close-up still from The Matrix: two open hands held out palms up against a dark background, the left holding a shiny red pill and the right a translucent blue pill.
use: A choice between two options. The red pill stands for the hard truth or the bold, risky option and the blue pill for the comfortable illusion or the safe choice, with a label on each pill or hand.
slots: label for the red pill (left hand)
label for the blue pill (right hand)

origin: Morpheus offers Neo a choice between a red pill and a blue pill in The Matrix (1999).
